title: TNS × EDP2 Explorer: lightcurves of TNS transients in the Rubin EDP2 footprint
description: A static browser of the 9,330 Transient Name Server transients discovered between 2025-02-24 and 2026-01-07 inside the Rubin Observatory EDP2 visit footprint: TNS, ZTF (ALeRCE) and public Rubin alert (Fink) photometry on one flux scale, TNS spectra, sky images and alert cutouts, broker and metaDEBASS classifications, and bulk downloads (docs/data/download/). Proprietary Rubin DP2 data are included only as ciphertext and are not part of the open files.
